scripts.build: if [ -d code-rs ]; then cd code-rs && cargo build --release --bin code --bin code-tui --bin code-exec; else echo 'skipping rust build: code-rs not found'; fi
scripts.build:dev: if [ -d code-rs ]; then cd code-rs && cargo build --bin code --bin code-tui --bin code-exec; else echo 'skipping rust build: code-rs not found'; fi
scripts.build:quick: if [ -d code-rs ]; then cd code-rs && cargo build --release --bin code; else echo 'skipping rust build: code-rs not found'; fi
scripts.test:local: if [ -d code-rs ]; then (cd code-rs && cargo run -p code-cli -- --version); elif [ -d codex-cli ]; then (cd codex-cli && npm link && codex --version); else echo 'no CLI workspace found' >&2; fi
scripts.fix: if [ -d code-rs ]; then cargo fmt && cargo fix --allow-dirty && cargo clippy --fix --allow-dirty; else echo 'skipping rust fix: code-rs not found'; fi
